comment: RULED R3c (13:35): record is a speech act, not a UI toggle. The start/stop events bracket an intentional demonstration; box geometry under the span means 'Julian is showing me something'. The drawer, by contrast, stays ephemeral (view state, no fold wants it).

domain.fold: pair record_start with its record_stop → demonstration spans

derives.demonstrations: spans [start,stop]; geometry/drag events within a span are communication, not just state
